_comment: M01's synthetic cast. UUIDs are uuid5 over the shared fixture namespace, so they are identical on every machine and in every language. Nothing here describes a real person. The login names are fictional and the passwords are test-only values that exist nowhere else.

O1.note: The owner. Last-owner protection applies: this account cannot lose the owner role while it is the only active holder, and its required 2FA cannot be disabled.

T1.note: Staff, so 2FA is required by the proposed minimum. Starts WITHOUT a factor to exercise enrol_factor_required.

G1.note: Guardian enforcement is school-configurable and NOT activated: optional here, pending owner policy. G1 enrols voluntarily so the optional path is covered.

P1.note: Holds auth.factor.reset_other, so it can approve T1's lost-device case. A different person from the subject, which the approval rule requires.

O2_SCHOOL_B.note: Exists solely to prove two-school isolation: every read by a School A actor against this account must be 404, never 403.

_two_factor_policy.proposed_minimum: Mandatory for owner, administrator and staff roles.
_two_factor_policy.status: PROPOSED, not an approved production policy.
_two_factor_policy.parent_student: School-configurable and shipped OFF pending owner policy. The seed exercises the configurable path through a fixture; a fixture cannot activate a production policy.

expired_challenge.note: Created already past its expiry so /auth/2fa/verify returns 401 error.challenge_expired without waiting five minutes.

used_recovery_code.note: Already consumed, so replaying it returns 409 error.recovery_code_already_used.

pending_reset_case.note: Open lost-device case awaiting P1's approval. Device-loss recovery with no SMS service.
